observations: The binary material has one connected broad rectangular slab, one centered lower narrow port, and four upper narrow ports.
Each upper port is a straight section followed by a linear flare into the slab; the lower port is a linear flare into the slab.
There are no bends, holes, crossings, or disconnected material regions.
topology_reasoning.interpretation: This is a reciprocal 1x4 multimode-interference splitter/combiner. The lower port is the common input/output and the four upper ports are the complementary output/input array.
topology_reasoning.calibrated_geometry: The supplied absolute renderer left-aligns and vertically centers the 25 x 10 um frame. The script therefore recreates the measured silhouette directly in that calibrated frame: a 19.4334 um by 3.7489 um slab, four 1.23 um nominal upper guides with 1.4141 um flares, and one 1.23 um lower guide with a 0.9251 um flare.
topology_reasoning.coordinate_note: Two 2 nm primitive registration tabs establish the supplied 25 x 10 um scoring frame while contributing only sub-pixel material at its extrema; all visible device material is the MMI slab, tapers, and guides.

iterations.change_made: Initial primitives-only 1x4 MMI assembly, dimensioned by direct inversion of the supplied absolute calibration. The reviewed diff contains only sub-pixel edge/anti-aliasing residuals, so no geometric refinement was warranted after exceeding the 0.85 stopping threshold. The emitted assembly is flattened only so the independent knob-area measurement reads its real layer-(1,0) material.
